title: Toledo — Equation Library of the Human–AI Readout Programme
description: The permanent, coded registry of every equation in the Human–AI Readout Programme together with its Coq (Th_coqc) formalisation. Th_coqc certifies that a lemma is closed under a stated finite model's global context — an internal-consistency check, never an empirical or physical truth claim. v1.2 extends the root registry with the Theta programme and Causal-Memory Closure (CMC) as roots (912 entries total, 592 root rows), completes statement formatting (LaTeX alongside ASCII for most entries) and redesigns the printable catalogue. Each entry carries an honest coq_status (closed, definition, wrapped_related, mapped_not_wrapped, open_prop, or not_formalisable). Scope: equations and Th_coqc only; papers, books and prose live in their own records and cite Toledo codes.
